nodes.label: setup.ps1 / setup.sh Bootstrap
nodes.rationale: forks + clones CyberDrain/CIPP, installs pinned graphify, builds the graph cold on first run (minutes); -SkipGraph / --skip-graph defers it

nodes.label: Bug Report Issue Template
nodes.rationale: requires repro on latest released versions of CIPP and CIPP-API, duplicate search, front/back end version numbers; labels unconfirmed-by-user + bug

nodes.label: Issue Template Config
nodes.rationale: blank issues disabled; security reports routed to GitHub security advisories, support to community Discord

nodes.label: Feature Request Issue Template
nodes.rationale: gated to $99 sponsors; auto-closes in 14 days without progress; volunteers claim work by commenting "I'd like to work on this please!"; repeat requests allowed 30 days after close

nodes.label: CIPP Frontend Alert Registrar (CIPP-Alert-Agent)
nodes.rationale: scope strictly limited to appending alert metadata entries to src/data/alerts.json after a backend Get-CIPPAlert*.ps1 alert is added; must touch no other file

nodes.label: CIPP Frontend Alert Registrar (CIPP-Frontend-Alert-Agent)
nodes.rationale: scope strictly limited to appending alert metadata entries to src/data/alerts.json after a backend Get-CIPPAlert*.ps1 alert is added; must touch no other file

nodes.label: Dependabot Config
nodes.rationale: weekly npm updates for /frontend and github-actions updates, both targeting the dev branch with chore-prefixed conventional commits

nodes.label: Pull App Fork Sync Config
nodes.rationale: auto-merges KelvinTegelaar main and website branches into fork; dev uses mergeMethod none so it never auto-merges
nodes.community_name: Pull App Fork Sync Config cluster

nodes.label: Check for Version Update Workflow
nodes.rationale: PRs to main/master must bump public/version.json; also fails any PR touching .github/workflows/*.yml to block workflow tampering
nodes.community_name: Check for Version Update Workflow cluster

nodes.label: Close Stale Issues Workflow
nodes.rationale: issues stale at 9 days, closed 5 days later; planned/bug/roadmap labels exempt; PRs never staled (days-before-pr-stale -1); bumping discouraged because it interferes with triage

nodes.label: Validate JSON Workflow
nodes.rationale: uses pull_request_target so the token can comment on fork PRs; PR code is checked out as data only and parsed by the trusted base validator, never executed

nodes.label: CIPP Sponsorware Policy
nodes.rationale: feature requests and support limited to paying sponsors to keep backlog manageable and fund training, development, documentation, and security checks; enforced via !notasponsor, !support, !incomplete comment commands

nodes.label: Dependency Review Workflow
nodes.rationale: fails PRs introducing dependencies with known vulnerabilities at moderate+ severity, blocking at merge time

nodes.label: ISO 27001:2022 A.8.28/8.29 Evidence
nodes.rationale: compliance controls for secure coding and security testing; SCA and DAST workflows exist as audit evidence for these controls

nodes.label: Build Dev Container Workflow
nodes.rationale: BuildKit cache mounts are not exported by type=gha, so yarn and Next.js caches are persisted via actions/cache and injected with buildkit-cache-dance to avoid cold compiles

nodes.label: Build Nightly Container Workflow
nodes.rationale: daily 23:00 UTC build skipped when dev has no commits in the last 24h; shares gha cache scope and key prefix with the dev workflow since both build the identical Dockerfile

nodes.label: PR Branch Check Workflow
nodes.rationale: auto-closes fork PRs targeting or originating from main/master, redirecting update attempts to the self-hosting guide and code contributions to the dev branch

nodes.label: Build Release Container Workflow
nodes.rationale: separate cache key prefix and gha scope from dev/nightly because release builds a different Dockerfile/base image

nodes.label: Sync Legacy Frontend Repository Workflow
nodes.rationale: mirrors frontend/ from CyberDrain/CIPP to KelvinTegelaar/CIPP; same diff/full-sync logic as the backend sync workflow

nodes.label: DAST OWASP ZAP Scan Workflow
nodes.rationale: weekly passive baseline scan plus on-demand full active scan against STAGING_URL (test-tenant data only, never production); findings filed as GitHub issues

nodes.label: Contributor License Agreement (CLA)
nodes.rationale: contributions automatically transfer copyright to CyberDrain without signing; enables CyberDrain to relicense under custom or commercial terms for sponsors

nodes.label: CIPP (CyberDrain Improved Partner Portal)
nodes.rationale: multi-tenant M365 management portal for Microsoft Partners; exists because Microsoft Lighthouse development lags market needs

nodes.label: CIPP Monorepo Structure
nodes.rationale: frontend/ (Next.js), backend/ (PowerShell on Craft runtime), build/ (Docker tooling) combined into a single containerized deployment

nodes.label: CIPP Security Policy
nodes.rationale: only the current release is supported; vulnerabilities reported via security@cyberdrain.com or Discord, disclosed publicly after resolution; $50 bounty for critical RCE/data-leak bugs

nodes.label: CIPP Notification Email Template
nodes.rationale: MJML-style Outlook-compatible HTML with .NET-format placeholders {0} title/preheader, {1} body, {2} button href, {3} button text, {4} footer

nodes.label: CIPP-API Azure Function App Deploy Workflow
nodes.norm_label: cipp-api azure function app deploy workflow

nodes.label: CIPP Azure Static Web Apps CI/CD Workflow
nodes.norm_label: cipp azure static web apps ci/cd workflow

nodes.label: CIPP (CyberDrain Improved Partner Portal)
nodes.rationale: created by Kelvin Tegelaar in 2021 to fill gaps left by existing M365 multi-tenant management solutions, centralize client administration in one portal

nodes.label: CIPP UI (React frontend on Azure Static Web Apps)
nodes.norm_label: cipp ui (react frontend on azure static web apps)

nodes.label: Craft Contributor License Agreement
nodes.rationale: contributions auto-transfer copyright to CyberDrain with no signature; enables CyberDrain to relicense including custom/commercial licenses for sponsors

nodes.label: Security Policy
nodes.rationale: report via security@cyberdrain.com or Discord admins; reports published after resolution; $50 bounty for critical RCE/data-leak bugs, swag otherwise

nodes.label: CIPP OpenAPI v2 Snapshot
nodes.rationale: auto-generated OpenAPI 3.1 spec from static analysis of backend + frontend, generated 2026-03-02; point-in-time snapshot covering 488 of 618 http entrypoints as of 2026-07-21, not regenerated by this repo's tooling
